summary: Iteration 5: Verified team CRUD/photo uploads, availability capacity clamping, portfolio image_paths, Premium (30km free) transport recalculation, and admin booking sort. Backend pytest 9/9 pass. UI verified: admin login, Tim tab with team-add-button, team-editor-modal fields on desktop and mobile 390 px (no horizontal overflow), calendar-team-capacity shows dynamic slot count, public BookingForm shows exact availability messages for full/limited/available, submit blocked on full, Premium package shows exact notice 'Selamat, kakak dapat diskon biaya transport radius 30km', 25km transport Rp 0, 31km Rp 5.000. Server-side POST /api/bookings recalculates transport ignoring forged client value.
critical_code_review_comments: Booking model has no status enum whitelist; client may pass arbitrary status. Consider Literal['pending','confirmed','completed','cancelled'].
Public POST /api/bookings has no auth; anyone can create/delete-list orders (delete is protected, list is protected). This is intentional per app design but rate limiting could be considered.
TeamManager modal is functional but photo_path stored as raw storage path or /assets/*; resolveImage handles both — good.
AdminDashboard CalendarTab renders calendar-slots-<iso> only for the currently displayed month grid — expected but keep in mind for future testing (iso not found if month not shown).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all exact strings + mobile modal + calendar capacity)

seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_ personel, TEST_ portfolio, TEST_ bookings, and 3 test availability dates (2026-07-04/11/18). All cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login page uses generic <input> without type=email; use nth-input targeting or placeholder 'Username atau email admin'. Public form is at '/' and requires scroll_into_view. Public booking submit still requires bukti transfer (proof file) — public form cannot submit end-to-end without a file upload. Availability POST expects {date, remaining_slots}; server derives status.
rca of the issue: No issues found. All new features (team CRUD with photo, capacity-based availability, portfolio image_paths, Premium 30km free radius, booking date/time sort) work correctly end-to-end.
